## 解决什么问题 / Problem

<!-- 关联 Issue（如有）；写清原先哪一步卡住，而不只列文件。 / Link an issue if applicable; describe the user's problem. -->

## 玩家会看到什么变化 / User-visible change

<!-- 说明为什么这样改；涉及界面请附相关前后截图。 / Explain the change and add before/after screenshots for UI work. -->

## 验证 / Verification

<!-- 列出实际执行的命令、结果，以及浏览器/设备。未验证项如实说明。 / List commands, results, browser/device checks and anything not verified. -->

- [ ] `npm run verify` 通过 / passed
- [ ] 相关回归测试已补充，或说明为何仅文档改动无需新增测试 / Regression coverage added, or documentation-only reason stated
- [ ] 涉及 UI 时已检查键盘、手机布局、深色和减少动效，或列明未验证项 / UI checks completed or gaps stated
- [ ] 原玩法、同条件对照、草稿和学习记录保留；涉及旧 JSON 时已验证回放 / Existing play, comparisons, drafts and records preserved; affected old JSON replay checked
- [ ] 无凭证、私密记录、无权使用的素材或无关生成文件 / No secrets, private records, unlicensed assets or unrelated output

## 边界与 AI 协助 / Limits and AI assistance

<!-- 不适用写“无”。用了 AI 请写它改了哪部分、你亲自核对了什么；不贴私密对话。不把流程完成写成学习者掌握。 / If AI assisted, say what it did and what you verified; do not paste private conversations or infer mastery from completion. -->
